source_scope: Public UnwindCode.ai homepage and published transmissions with claim/evidence labels for retrieval safety
retrieval_notes: This registry labels public claims before broad RAG, chat grounding, or proof/audit expansion.
Entries preserve claim text, source routes, citations, evidence status, interpretation boundaries, and risk labels.
No credentials, private prompts, user data, provider configuration, runtime logs, hidden procedures, or deployment evidence are included.
